posts.caption: Thank you for visiting EL FARM! 🌿✨ Nothing beats sharing a bountiful Salu-Salo Bilao and specialty iced coffee with family under our farm pavilion in Sitio Nipa.
Malayo man kami, sulit naman ang dayo! 🥥🍵 Thank you to our wonderful guests for spending your afternoon with us over Coconut Matcha Cloud and Golden Crispy Pata!
Spotted at EL FARM: Doc Mika & CHO LGU Lamitan family! 💚 Thank you for celebrating with our Seafood Feast Bilao and heirloom Basilan dishes!
Coffee dates and golden hour vibes at Sitio Nipa! ☕🌴 Try our signature Dirty Coffee and Butter Caramel Popcorn Latte on your next visit.
Al-fresco garden nights under the starlight sail canopies! ✨lantern-lit trees, warm acoustics, and freshly cooked Native Chicken Tinola & Tiyula Itum.
Thank you Calugusan Elementary School Faculty for choosing El Farm Cafe & Resto for your fellowship dinner! 🥂🍽️ See you again soon!
Post-pickleball recovery feast! 🏓🔥 Nothing hits the spot after an intense night rally quite like Sizzling Pork Sisig, Pancit Miki Bilao, and ice-cold yoghurt drinks!
Weekend barkada hangout in Brgy. Maloong Canal! 🌿🍹 From Dubai Chewy Cookie Smoothies to Barkadahan Platters, every craving has a home here at El Farm.
Smiles all around our handcrafted live-edge acacia tables! 🪵✨ Thank you for making El Farm part of your family's weekend traditions in Lamitan City.
LCEA Pickleball Club owning the night court under the palms! 🏓🌴 Book your court time and pre-order your Salu-Salo feast ahead of arrival!
Sweet moments and ceremonial matcha! 🍵💚 Have you tried our EL Special Matcha (Dunya) and Coconut Matcha Cloud in a real buko shell yet?
Good food, great company, and the peaceful breeze of Sitio Nipa. 🌾🍽️ Open daily from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM for dine-in, pre-order, and Lamitan delivery!
Thank you to our guests from Isabela City & Lamitan City for dropping by tonight! 🌟 Your support inspires our kitchen every single day.
Rainy evening comfort: Putok Batok Bone Marrow Goto, Goto Overload, and hot Spanish Lattes shared with the best crew! 🥣☕
Birthday Salu-Salo under the garden lights! 🎂🎉 Message us at 0917 182 9876 to reserve our garden tables for your next milestone celebration.
Every table tells a story at EL FARM CAFÉ & RESTO. 🌿✨ Escape the ordinary and visit us at Sitio Nipa, Brgy. Maloong Canal, Lamitan City!
